entry.title: Updated: dsh-quota-panel
entry.summary: Bottom-right quota capsule that auto-discovers every configured provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, GLM, one-api/new-api, coding plans) and shows balance or rolling 5-hour and weekly usage, with per-provider visibility, alert thresholds and proxy support. Exact install spec: dsh-quota-panel. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
